title: Pod CrashLoopBackOff
description: Pod is crash-looping — container starts, fails, and Kubernetes keeps restarting it with exponential backoff.
root_causes: Application startup error (bad config, missing env var)

remediation_steps.description: Force pod recreation — clears backoff timer
Sync from Git to ensure latest healthy config

manual_checks: kubectl logs <pod> --previous — check last crash reason
kubectl describe pod <pod> — check Events section
